tools.name: foliade_account
tools.description: Confirms the address and the plan of the destination account, without secrets or payment data.

tools.name: foliade_list_catalogues
tools.description: Lists the private and public catalogues of the connected account, with pagination.

tools.name: foliade_prepare_upload
tools.description:
Creates a single-use 10-minute deposit. Compute the size and the SHA-256 of the local PDF.

    Transfer the bytes to upload_url with PUT, Content-Type application/pdf,
    with the headers returned. Do not publish these headers in your reply.
    This ticket allows no reading and is not an API key

tools.name: foliade_finalize_upload
tools.description:
Finalises an upload that has been received. A repeat returns the same catalogue, never a duplicate.

    Conversion is asynchronous: check foliade_catalogue_status before
    giving the final result. The catalogue stays private until it is published explicitly.

tools.name: foliade_catalogue_status
tools.description: Private state: owner OAuth or guest token, never the public link alone.

tools.name: foliade_publish_catalogue
tools.description: Makes the catalogue public, on explicit request only. Keeps its identifier.

tools.name: foliade_catalogue_stats
tools.description: Aggregated statistics: reads and contacts, without disclosing the contact details.

tools.name: foliade_unpublish_catalogue
tools.description: Closes the public link without deleting the data. Requires an explicit request.

tools.name: foliade_capabilities
tools.description:
Effective entitlements, JSON schemas and examples. Read before configuring; omitted fields are kept, null is refused.

        Setting changes are visible immediately on a published catalogue.
        Binary media, PDF replacements, API keys, REST webhooks, team and billing stay in the workspace/API

tools.name: foliade_get_catalogue_settings
tools.description: Settings, table of contents, lead capture, protection without secrets, and the revision needed for changes.

tools.name: foliade_update_catalogue
tools.description:
Changes only the fields supplied: colours, bar, controls, sound, reading, logo, title, language, PDF.

        dry_run returns a preview without writing. No change to the publication state.

tools.name: foliade_set_catalogue_access
tools.description:
Changes access on explicit request only. Never publishes a draft. The password is never returned.

        Declaring a domain does not configure DNS/TLS; activation remains a separate operation.

tools.name: foliade_set_lead_capture
tools.description: Sets activation, page, blocking mode, fields and consent. A plan with lead capture is required; email is mandatory.

tools.name: foliade_set_chapters
tools.description: Replaces the table of contents with the ordered list supplied; an empty list removes it.

tools.name: foliade_import_chapters
tools.description: Merges the PDF bookmarks into the table of contents without duplicates.

tools.name: foliade_get_brand
tools.description: Brand name, colour and default PDF download; without any billing information.

tools.name: foliade_update_brand
tools.description: Account-wide impact: use it when a global customisation is asked for, prefer update_catalogue for a single PDF.

tools.name: foliade_list_themes
tools.description: Account themes, their settings and revisions; a theme is a copy, not a live link.

tools.name: foliade_create_theme
tools.description: Saves the existing styling and media of the catalogue as a theme, within the limit of the plan.

tools.name: foliade_update_theme
tools.description: Changes the theme for its future applications. make_default changes the starting point of new catalogues.

tools.name: foliade_apply_theme
tools.description: Copies the styling and media of a theme of this account onto this catalogue.

tools.name: foliade_get_enrichments
tools.description: Elements, published version, differences and revision. The files remain those of the catalogue.

tools.name: foliade_update_enrichments
tools.description:
Replaces the draft: 13 types, links, buttons, videos, forms, products, galleries, tours, questions.

        No element that is invalid or closed off by the plan is accepted. Nothing is published before publish_enrichments.
        See capabilities and get_enrichments for the examples and the native

tools.name: foliade_publish_enrichments
tools.description: Publishes the interactive elements explicitly, with history. Does not publish the catalogue itself.

tools.name: foliade_restore_enrichments
tools.description: Restores a version of this catalogue after re-checking the plan; creates a new history entry.

tools.name: foliade_list_shelves
tools.description: Paginated list of the shelves and their settings, without passwords.

tools.name: foliade_get_shelf
tools.description: Settings, catalogues in order, and revision of the shelf.

tools.name: foliade_create_shelf
tools.description: Creates a shelf as a draft. The Distributeur plan is required; nothing is published automatically.

tools.name: foliade_update_shelf
tools.description: Texts, six layouts, covers, shelf boards, colours, fonts, collections, search and opening.

tools.name: foliade_set_shelf_catalogues
tools.description: Replaces the contents of the shelf with this ordered list with collection names. The PDFs themselves are kept.

tools.name: foliade_set_shelf_access
tools.description: Publication and access of the shelf on explicit request only; DNS/TLS remain separate.

tools.name: foliade_list_tracking_links
tools.description: Named links of the catalogue owned by the account. Contains the recipients; do not disclose them publicly.

tools.name: foliade_create_tracking_link
tools.description: Creates a named Business link. No email is sent; does not publish the catalogue.

tools.name: foliade_update_tracking_link
tools.description: Changes recipient, note, email or active flag; closing is explicit and reversible, with no message sent.
